prompt: What percentage of the global mobile population is covered by 2G networks in 2024, according to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU)?
answer: According to the ITU, **about 98% of the world’s population was covered by a 2G mobile network in 2024**. This refers to population living within range of a 2G signal, whether or not they subscribed to or used the service.
